description_zh: He Fangsheng（贺方升，品牌名贺去病；另用名 Dosen）的个人网站。深圳独立开发者、企业 AI 交付工程师，贺去病商业咨询创始人。
description_en: Personal site of He Fangsheng (贺方升), publicly known as Hequbing (贺去病) and also known as Dosen. Shenzhen-based independent developer and enterprise AI delivery engineer.
disambiguation: 贺去病 is the public brand name of He Fangsheng (贺方升). This is not the Han-dynasty general Huo Qubing (霍去病).
